feature_title: Create a FastAPI inventory service using uv and Python 3.14 (requires-python >=3.14): items have name, unique sku, quantity >= 0 and price; endpoints create an item, list items with limit/offset pagination and a name filter, get an item by sku, and adjust stock with POST /items/{sku}/adjust taking a delta that may not drive quantity below zero (409); pytest tests using FastAPI's TestClient, verified by uv run pytest -q.
warnings: GET /items accepts limit and offset as plain query params with no Field constraints (e.g. ge=0), so a negative limit or offset silently falls through to Python slice semantics instead of returning a 422; the pagination test only covers the happy path.

InventoryStore.create and .adjust are check-then-act (membership/read check followed by a separate dict write) with no lock; FastAPI runs sync def handlers in a threadpool, so two concurrent requests for the same sku can both pass the check and race on the write (e.g. two creates for the same sku both succeeding, or a lost update on adjust). No test exercises concurrent access.
